what_to_detect: A candidate for a spell with improvise is affordable because untapped artifacts its controller controls can pay generic mana in its total cost.
near_miss: A candidate for a spell with improvise that is unaffordable: too few untapped artifacts and other sources for its generic mana.
record_fields: candidates[].ability (the spell's own line; Improvise is a separate keyword line on the same card)
entity tapped state of the controller's artifacts

what_to_detect: A candidate for a spell with two or more instances of improvise is affordable with at most one untapped artifact per generic mana; the extra instance adds no payment.
near_miss: A candidate for such a spell that is unaffordable: fewer untapped artifacts and other sources than its generic mana.
record_fields: candidates[].ability (the spell's own line; Improvise is a separate keyword line on the same card)
